topic: Dashboard release and future analytics scope
summary_markdown:
The session covered the successful staging and release of a dashboard update (ver.0.8.10). Following the release, a discussion arose regarding adding a real-time traffic view that aggregates data across all countries, rather than viewing it by country.

It was noted that implementing this feature would require removing the current level of detail to support larger geographical areas (e.g., South/North America, East/West Europe). The feasibility and timing of this advanced analytics request were discussed, with participants agreeing that while desirable, it should be addressed much later.
decisions: The real-time, aggregated traffic view is deferred to a much later date.
